newsitem.title: USA: NY-NJ Port Auth still wants Fri bond sale - source.
newsitem.headline: NY-NJ Port Auth still wants Fri bond sale - source.

text.p: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey still wants to sell about $932 million of airport improvement bonds on Friday but no decision has been made, a source familiar with the deal said Thursday.
"The latest thing is (Lehman) will try and get it done on Friday, but it's not definite," said the source, who declined to be named.
Lehman Brothers, the lead underwriter, has said it was polling institutional investors to see whether they had gotten the necessary credit approvals.

The syndicate prefers to sell the bonds this week because next week has several potentially market-moving economic reports and other offerings that could compete with the Port Authority's sale, including a $635 million bond sale by the New York City Municipal Water Finance Authority.
